observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a flatbed industrial sewing machine head with a white body and red 'EMEL' logo, mounted on a metal/white table stand with drawer unit.
A model code resembling 'EM-8500' is visible on the machine arm in both photos.
A box beside the table reads 'EMEL CLUTCH MOTOR EM250A-H', indicating a clutch-motor industrial setup rather than a servo motor.
A measuring tape, scissors, bobbins, and thread spools are visible on and around the table, suggesting some accessories are present.
No power cord, foot pedal in use, or running/stitching demonstration is visible in either photo.
No visible manual, warranty card, or country-of-origin marking (e.g., 'Made in Japan') is legible in either image.
Floor and wall show a lived-in workshop setting, consistent with home/small business use rather than a showroom.

claims.evidence: No purchase receipt, date stamp, or usage log visible in either photo.
No video or photo shows the machine powered on, stitching, or the motor running; only static shots are given.
No country-of-origin marking is legible on the machine plate in photo 0 or 1; brand 'EMEL' and motor box do not show a Japan origin stamp.

claims.claim: All accessories and original manual included
claims.evidence: Only scissors, tape, and bobbins are visible; no manual or full accessory set (e.g., extra needles, oil, spare bobbins) is shown or confirmed.

claims.claim: Never serviced because nothing ever went wrong
claims.evidence: No service record or internal mechanism photo to confirm lack of wear or repairs.

risks.risk: Motor and stitching mechanism may not actually run smoothly or at all despite claim.
risks.proof: A short video clip of the machine powered on and stitching a test seam.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / needing repair

risks.risk: Origin of the brand 'EMEL' is unclear; may be a Chinese-made machine mislabeled as Japanese.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the nameplate showing country of manufacture.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown/non-premium origin, not as a Japanese-brand premium machine

risks.risk: Missing or incomplete accessories (extra needles, oil bottle, manual) could add hidden cost to buyer.
risks.proof: A photo laying out all included accessories and the manual booklet together.
risks.if_unproven: priced as base machine only, no accessory premium

risks.risk: Internal wear (bearing noise, belt condition, needle plate wear) not visible from outside photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine running under load for at least 30 seconds with audible motor sound.
risks.if_unproven: priced at lower end assuming moderate wear

proof_requests: Video of the machine powered on, stitching a sample fabric, showing smooth motor operation.
Close-up photo of the nameplate/serial plate showing brand, model, and country of manufacture.
Photo of all included accessories (manual, extra needles, oil, bobbins) laid out together.
Photo or receipt showing purchase date to support the '1 year used' claim.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as an EMEL industrial flatbed lockstitch sewing machine with a clutch motor and table stand, but none of the seller's performance, origin, or completeness claims are verifiable from the photos, so it must be priced at the worst case of an unverified-working industrial machine.
